# Sales definitions

The finance team counts revenue on completed orders only. Cancelled orders retain their amounts and are excluded from revenue. The booked-order dashboard includes cancelled orders to track demand; it is not the revenue definition.

All amounts in this sample are EUR, tax included. Each line amount is quantity multiplied by unit_price. There are no additional order-level discounts, fees or shipping amounts in this sample. Item amounts therefore reconcile to order totals. Orders may have several items and products. A product is identified by product_id; its name is only a display label.
